# Hasan Shahmoradi — حسن شاهمرادی (Full Knowledge Base)

> Iranian web designer, front-end developer, digital strategist, and vibe coding educator based in Tehran.
> 8+ years building digital products, e-commerce stores, and teaching people to ship software with AI tools.
> https://hasanshah.ir — languages: Persian (fa), English (en), Arabic (ar)

## About Hasan Shahmoradi
Hasan Shahmoradi (Persian: حسن شاهمرادی) is a web designer and front-end developer from Tehran, Iran. He has over 8 years of professional experience building digital products and online stores for Iranian and international clients, and teaches vibe coding — a method of building software by directing AI models rather than writing code by hand.

Technical stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Cursor, Claude AI, Codex, GitHub, Vercel.

## Core Services
1. Web Design and Development: High-converting landing pages, e-commerce systems, and full-stack web applications.
2. Free 72-Hour One-Page Website: Custom-designed single-page website delivered on a staging domain within 72 hours for free, with 30 days to review before deciding on any further work.
3. Vibe Coding Masterclasses: Interactive workshops and structured education teaching entrepreneurs and non-programmers to build production software with AI.

## Career Journey & Story Timeline (About Page)
- URL: https://hasanshah.ir/about/
- Description: Full interactive visual album and career roadmap of Hasan Shahmoradi across five distinct epochs:
  1. 2018–2019 (1397–1398): "3soot" On-Demand Warm Bread Logistics Startup (3soot.app) — first entrepreneurship venture, mobile app launch, and market validation.
  2. 2019–2020 (1398–1399): Startup Shutdown & COVID-19 Era — key lessons from failure, business resilience, and strategic pivot toward value creation and sales psychology.
  3. 2020–2023 (1399–1402): 5 Years of Heavy Video Marketing & Industrial Copywriting — viral reels, B2B commercial campaigns (e.g. mr_countertop.ir), and mastering viewer retention hooks.
  4. 2023–2024 (1402–1403): Front-end Engineering & High-Converting Websites — building custom React/Next.js/WordPress sites with a 72-hour zero-risk delivery offer.
  5. 2024–Present: Leading Vibe Coding in Iran — teaching entrepreneurs to ship complete web apps and digital products by directing AI models in Persian.
